entries.name: Large salad, egg salad & small chicken taco
entries.notes: Scoop of egg salad, big salad with soybeans, nuts, a few grapes, a little feta, quinoa, champagne vinaigrette, one small chicken taco. Assumes ½ cup egg salad and a larger usual salad. Approximate working portion; edit to match what you ate.

entries.name: Tuna tartare, avocado, squash & grilled chicken
entries.notes: Assumes 3 oz tuna, 4 oz chicken, ¼ avocado, 1 cup squash and tomatoes, some oil.

entries.name: Grapes & cottage cheese
entries.notes: Assumes ½ cup cottage cheese and a few grapes.
